title: Mid-Harness: Scaling Actions Between Model and Harness for Terminal Agents
selection_reason: Mid-Harness evaluates test-time action sampling and verification at the model/harness boundary and reports better success at lower estimated token cost, directly matching inference-time compute/runtime efficiency.
